warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number. Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).

Widths: where two widths are printed (0.90/0.80, 0.80/0.70) the outer one is the frame (width_m) and the inner one the leaf (leaf_width_m). Heights measured to ▼ระดับพื้นห้อง; windows print sill + opening (0.85 + 1.20 = 2.05; น3 1.65 + 0.50 = 2.15).
น3 is drawn as a small top-hung/awning-looking light but its schedule row says หน้าต่างบานเลื่อน — kept as printed.
